purpose: Limit what is true or possible to a narrow case.
keywords: Plain clause / N + くらいのものだ
About the only people using this road are locals.
Weekends are about the only time I can read at leisure.
About all I can do is listen.
formation: Plain clause / N + くらいのものだ
restrictions: Often follows a limited example such as 私 or 週末.
mistake: The phrase restricts the set; it does not simply express size.
